stem.text: An object falls freely from rest in a vacuum. The graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the velocity $v$ of the object.

stem.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing a straight line from the origin.

stem.text: Which graph, **using the same scales**, represents the object falling in air?

A.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing a straight line from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing a curve from the origin that rises and levels off.

C.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing a curve from the origin.

D.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, showing a curve from the origin that becomes steeper.
